```{r draft-watermark, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (isTRUE(knitr::is_html_output())) {
  cat("```{=html}\n")
  cat("<script>\n")
  cat("document.addEventListener(\"DOMContentLoaded\", function () {\n")
  cat("  document.body.classList.add(\"draft-watermark\");\n")
  cat("  document.body.setAttribute(\"data-watermark\", \"DRAFT - DO NOT CITE OR REDISTRIBUTE\");\n")
  cat("});\n")
  cat("</script>\n")
  cat("```\n")
}
